analysis_plan.estimand: paired treatment-minus-control effect over the frozen workload
analysis_plan.analysis_population_rule: all frozen task/configuration/repetition cells with raw manifests
analysis_plan.missing_data_rule: do not impute; report missingness by reason and configuration
analysis_plan.blocked_run_rule: BLOCKED remains a separate outcome and is not converted to failure or success
analysis_plan.protocol_deviation_rule: analyze deviations separately and report both frozen-set and sensitivity views
analysis_plan.multiplicity_rule: primary metric is confirmatory; secondary metrics are descriptive unless corrected
analysis_plan.outlier_rule: retain all valid runs; no outcome-based trimming
